review_notes: Read all 38 actual Luke 3 source units, all 34 proposed source/target comparisons and rationales, all seven deferral reasons, and relevant surrounding contexts from the exact original cache.

All target IDs and original-order contiguous ranges resolve. Pair keys are unique, no target includes its own source unit, and paired plus deferred source coverage is exactly the full 38-unit chapter.

The John ministry comparisons preserve crowds versus Pharisees/Sadducees, inward speculation versus emissaries' questions, and general good-news summaries versus specific repentance-baptism preaching. Tax-collector baptism is explicitly an internal callback rather than independent dialogue attestation.

The money-contentment comparison supports the soldiers' pay clause only; Hebrews is not represented as independently repeating the extortion and false-accusation commands. The different speakers and practical applications remain clear.

Isaiah 40:3–5 has been compared against this edition's actual paths, valleys, rough-country and salvation wording. Mark's water/Spirit wording and into Him differ from Luke's added fire and bodily form/upon Him as the rationale states.

Genealogical comparisons are partial and disclose their differences. Heli/Jacob, Neri/Jechoniah, Rhesa/Abiud, Nathan/Solomon, Sala/Salman, Admin-and-Arni/Arran, and Cainan/Kenan are not silently harmonized or treated as automatically identical forms.

Genesis 11:13 actually contains the Cainan-to-Shelah continuation within its original unit; the target preserves that unit and distinguishes this post-Flood Cainan from the earlier Cainan in Luke 3:37. Genesis 17:5 explicitly documents Abram's name change as broader context.

The shared Nahor–Terah–Abram portion is supported by Genesis 11:24–26 without confusing Terah's father Nahor with Terah's also-named son. The target's additional names and chronological ages are not imported into Luke.

Samuel supports the Nathan–David portion, Chronicles the Lamech–Noah–Shem portion, and Genesis the God-created-Adam/Seth/Enosh portion only within their declared limits. Creation is not converted into biological divine generation.
The named chronological list and six unmatched ancestry units are conservatively deferred. Merely recurring names do not establish identities, famous-author connections, or parent-child links.
